title.es: Qué llevar a la clase de cocina
title.en: What to Bring to the Cooking Class

intro.es: Practica lectura de inglés A2 con un texto original sobre adult learning.
intro.en: Practise A2 English reading with an original text about adult learning.

mission.es: Identifica la idea global, comprueba la evidencia y reconstruye la secuencia.
mission.en: Identify the main idea, check evidence, and reconstruct the sequence.

content.targetText: The community centre cooking class starts next Tuesday at six thirty. This month we are learning to make vegetable dumplings and a simple dipping sauce. The centre will provide bowls, knives, and all ingredients, but students should bring a clean apron and a container for leftovers. Please tell the tutor about allergies when you arrive. The kitchen has only eight workstations, so students who cannot attend should cancel by Monday morning. Beginners are welcome, and the tutor demonstrates each step slowly before anyone tries it. Because places are limited, the centre keeps a short waiting list and opens a second group on Thursday whenever enough people ask. The class ends at eight, and everyone can stay for a short tasting session.
